evidence_boundary: R02 is a schema-only revision bound to the immutable R01 38/40 E0 static failure. It changes only the R02 diagnostic evidence source: instead of reading a nonexistent route_diagnostics object from the R02 runner report, the static checker hash-binds and recomputes maxima from the already persisted 247-row ngspice, Xyce and route-difference CSV files that the immutable runner report registered and the 24/24 independent checker reproduced. The hypothesis, three expression points, branch sentinel, three original/portable candidate points, tools, exact two-process serial budget, thresholds, failure retention and all no-downstream rules remain unchanged. Static checking invokes no simulator and creates no probe netlist or numerical output. A future runner may invoke ngspice and Xyce once each only after a separately committed 40/40 E3 PASS. Even a complete chain can establish only the numerical expression-semantics cause and a bounded portable-expression remedy at those probes. It cannot establish physical IGZO parameters, experimental calibration, full 247-row route agreement, formal M01 closure, circuit readiness, layout, PEX or HZO evidence.
